statement:
∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (t : ZMod p) (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p),
  (∑ x : (ZMod p)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod p)) * ψ (t - (x : ZMod p))) =
    if t = 0 then (if χ = ψ then (p.totient : ℂ) * ψ (-1) else 0)
    else star (χ t) * ψ t * jacobiSum χ⁻¹ ψ

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0011 · 核对素模反射的 Jacobi 相位及零目标的对角项
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0011 · Compute the Jacobi phase at a prime modulus and the diagonal at target zero

brief.zh: 非零 t 时换元 x=t·y，并保留两特征各自的相位。t=0 时用单位群正交性，实二次特征已有结论可用作检验。
brief.en: For t≠0 use x=t·y and keep the separate phases of both characters. For t=0 use orthogonality on the unit group. The existing real quadratic result supplies a check.
